channel.title: arXiv Daily Briefing (Adam)
channel.description: Daily audio rundown of astro-ph: star formation, the CMZ, ISM, astrochemistry.
channel.itunes:author: Claude for Adam Ginsburg

item.title: arXiv briefing, Wednesday November 4, 2026
item.description: 20 papers; no salt papers today. Deep dives: He I resonant scattering in M17; Galactic 10Be and the early Solar System; the missing triphenylene in TMC-1; carbon destruction in the Class I disk HOPS-68; UV spectra of little red dots.

item.title: arXiv briefing, Tuesday November 3, 2026
item.description: 20 papers; no salt papers today. Deep dives: chemistry of DESI-312, a star ejected from the Galactic Center; proper motions in a Serpens South outflow; dark helium features in Orion; HNCO in the L1157 filament; a gravitational-wave pair and a Type IIb supernova.

item.title: arXiv briefing, Monday November 2, 2026
item.description: 20 papers; no salt molecules, atomic sodium in a white dwarf. Deep dives: R Mon as a Class I protostar; a possible cloud collision in NGC 6357; gamma rays from S106; missing binary neutron star mergers; OASIS quiet galaxies at high redshift.

item.title: arXiv briefing, Wednesday October 28, 2026
item.description: 20 papers; no salt papers today. Deep dives: collimated jet-driven outflow in Sgr C (CMZ); What sets the Milky Way SFR? I and II; silicon-carbon chains in IRC+10216; JWST amorphous silicates in 3I/ATLAS; Starlink VHF telemetry decoded with 21CMA.
